learnings: Injecting dependencies (repository, notifier, clock) is what makes a package easy to test.
Factory fixtures, fakes and `create_autospec` mocks test behaviour without real e-mail or disk.
One deterministic CI command with a branch-coverage gate keeps quality from slipping.
pitfalls: Plain `Mock()` accepts any call; `create_autospec` fails when the real signature changes.
